articles.title: Supreme Court Starts New Term With Big Cases to Watch
articles.summary: The Supreme Court returns Monday for a new term with major cases on climate lawsuits and gun laws, and justices also handle fast emergency requests.

articles.title: G7 Nations to Release 100 Million Barrels of Oil and Diesel
articles.summary: The G7 agreed to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel to ease high fuel prices, after President Trump threatened to ban U.S. diesel exports.

articles.title: Student Protests Disrupt Hundreds of Schools in France
articles.summary: Student protests over education standards have disrupted 735 of France's 3,700 schools, and French ministers are responding to the unrest.
